The '''SaintapediaSuggest''' extension lets a reader propose a correction to one specific {{ll|Extension:Cargo|Cargo}} field stored for a page — a wrong phone number, an outdated address — without opening an edit form or understanding the underlying template. Editors triage what arrives at '''Special:SaintapediaSuggest'''. Nothing is ever written to Cargo or to wikitext directly: every suggestion is a queue entry a human reviews and applies (or dismisses) by hand.

It is a narrower, more structured sibling to {{ll|Extension:SaintapediaFeedback|SaintapediaFeedback}}'s free-text "Improve this article" panel — SaintapediaFeedback is for "this article is out of date"; SaintapediaSuggest is for "this one infobox field is wrong", where a specific before/after value is worth capturing precisely. The two can run side by side: when both are installed, SaintapediaFeedback's panel can offer readers a hand-off ("Correcting a specific fact instead?") into SaintapediaSuggest's picker.

Developed for [https://saintapedia.org/ Saintapedia].

== Features ==

* Field picker scoped to an explicit per-wiki allow-list — '''nothing is suggestable until a Cargo table is opted in''', the safe default rather than a misconfiguration
* Row-aware: a page that stores several rows in one Cargo table (several sightings, several Mass times) gets one picker entry per row, each named by a configurable label field, not a bare "Row 1/2/3"
* Server re-derives and snapshots the current stored value at submit time — the client's copy is never trusted
* Duplicate folding: a second reader proposing the same value joins the first as a corroborating report instead of opening a second queue item
* Freshness check on the dashboard: flags a suggestion the live Cargo value has already moved past, been actioned without the data changing, or matches what's already stored
* Editor dashboard: filter, search, bulk-action, per-article view, per-item audit-trail detail view, Copy / Edit-article shortcuts on each row
* Optional {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}} notifications to a named user list and to page watchers who already pass the dashboard-access check
* Optional contact-email field and JSON/offline export, each gated behind its own right, independent of dashboard access
* The Cargo table/field allow-list is itself overridable from a '''MediaWiki:''' page — add a table without a deploy — while access control, the rate limit, and CAPTCHA-required stay LocalSettings.php-only
* Fails closed: if captcha is required but unavailable, submissions are rejected rather than let through

== Installation ==

{{ExtensionInstall
|SaintapediaSuggest
|registration=required
|db-update=true
|custom-steps=* Requires {{ll|Extension:Cargo|Cargo}}, loaded first. Optional: {{ll|Extension:ConfirmEdit|ConfirmEdit}} for captcha, {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}} for notifications.
}}

Clone from GitHub (the directory must be named <code>SaintapediaSuggest</code>, not <code>Suggestor</code> — <code>wfLoadExtension()</code> resolves by directory):

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
cd extensions/
git clone --branch v0.8.1 --depth 1 https://github.com/Saintapedia/Suggestor.git SaintapediaSuggest
</syntaxhighlight>

Add to <code>LocalSettings.php</code>, '''after''' Cargo:

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
wfLoadExtension( 'Cargo' );
wfLoadExtension( 'SaintapediaSuggest' );
</syntaxhighlight>

The extension creates its own tables (<code>sps_suggestion</code>, <code>sps_suggestion_log</code>), so '''<code>update.php</code> must be run''' on install and after upgrades.

'''Nothing is suggestable until you allow-list a table''' — see [[#Configuration|Configuration]] below.

=== Optional dependencies ===

; {{ll|Extension:ConfirmEdit|ConfirmEdit}}
: Needed for captcha on submissions. Fails closed — if a captcha is required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is unavailable or misconfigured, the submission is rejected rather than silently accepted. If {{ll|Extension:SaintapediaFeedback|SaintapediaFeedback}} already loads ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha, this extension reuses the same site-wide configuration; do not load it twice.
; {{ll|Extension:Echo|Echo}}
: Enables notifications to the notify-user list and to watchers of the article. Without Echo, suggestions are still recorded; they simply do not notify.

== Configuration ==

=== The allow-list ===

<code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestTables</code> decides which (table, field) pairs are ever offered to a reader. Empty by default — installing the extension exposes nothing. A target must also exist in the live Cargo schema; this keeps a stale or hand-edited entry from reaching the database layer as an arbitrary identifier, and drops fields removed from a template since the allow-list was written. Underscore-prefixed Cargo internals (<code>_pageID</code>, <code>_ID</code>, …) are never suggestable, even under <code>'*'</code>.

<syntaxhighlight lang="php">
$wgSaintapediaSuggestTables = [
    'Parishes' => [ 'Address', 'Phone', 'Website' ],  // explicit fields
    'Dioceses' => '*',                                 // every non-internal field
];
</syntaxhighlight>

'''Allow-listing a field publishes its current stored value''', not just an affordance to correct it — the widget's "currently stored" line shows it to every reader, whether or not the article's template actually renders that field anywhere. Only allow-list fields you're comfortable making visible.

As of 0.7.0 this is also overridable from <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaSuggest-tables</code> (one <code>Table: Field1, Field2</code> / <code>Table: *</code> / bare <code>Table</code> line per table) without a deploy — see [[#Wiki config (MediaWiki: pages)|Wiki config]] below. A page whose content doesn't name any real, currently existing Cargo table falls back to the PHP list rather than disabling every suggestion wiki-wide.

=== Modes ===

<code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMode</code> selects a defaults profile:

{| class="wikitable"
! Mode !! For !! Captcha !! Rate limit !! Email field !! Dashboard access default
|-
| <code>public</code> (default) || Open reader-facing wikis || Required || 5 / IP / day || Off || sysop
|-
| <code>enterprise</code> || Logged-in intranet wikis || Off || 50 / IP / day || Available || sysop (set <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestAccessGroups</code> to widen)
|}

=== Main settings ===

; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMode</code>
: <code>public</code> or <code>enterprise</code>. Default: <code>public</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestNamespaces</code>
: Namespaces where the widget shows and the API accepts submissions. Default: <code>[ NS_MAIN ]</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestRowLabelField</code>
: Table => field naming each row in the picker, for tables where a page stores several rows. Unset tables fall back to the first allow-listed field with a value, then to "Row N". No wiki-page override.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMaxFields</code>
: Cap on (table, field) pairs exposed to one page's widget. Default: <code>40</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMaxValueLength</code>
: Max characters for a suggested value and the stored snapshot. Default: <code>500</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMaxRowsPerTable</code>
: Cap on rows of one Cargo table offered for a single page. Default: <code>50</code>. Also bounds row-id validation — a real row beyond this cap is invisible to the extension.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestFreshnessCheck</code> / <code>...MaxFreshnessLookups</code>
: Compare each dashboard suggestion against the live Cargo value and badge notable cases. Defaults: <code>true</code> / <code>50</code> distinct (page, table) pairs per screen.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestMergeDuplicates</code>
: Fold repeat reports of the same value into one queue item, counted on the canonical row. Default: <code>true</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestRateLimit</code> / <code>...EnterpriseRateLimit</code>
: Submissions per hashed IP per day, public/enterprise mode respectively. Defaults: <code>5</code> / <code>50</code>. LocalSettings.php only — not wiki-page overridable, an abuse control rather than content curation.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestRequireCaptcha</code>
: <code>null</code> = decide from mode; <code>true</code>/<code>false</code> to force. Default: <code>null</code>. LocalSettings.php only.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestEnableEmail</code>
: Show the optional contact-email field. Auto-on in enterprise mode. Default: <code>false</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestNotifyUsers</code> / <code>...NotifyWatchers</code> / <code>...NotifyEmail</code>
: Usernames to Echo-notify, whether to also notify watchers who already pass the dashboard-access check, and an optional single email address alerted per submission. Defaults: <code>[]</code> / <code>true</code> / <code>false</code>.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestAccessGroups</code> / <code>...EmailAccessGroups</code> / <code>...ExportAccessGroups</code>
: Groups granted dashboard access, contact-email visibility, and export, independently. All default to <code>[ 'sysop' ]</code>. LocalSettings.php only — a <code>*</code> token is never honored in <code>EmailAccessGroups</code>. Note: MediaWiki merges an extension's array-type config default with your override rather than replacing it, so the effective list actually includes <code>'sysop'</code> plus whatever you add.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestEnabled</code>
: Master switch for the reader widget; the dashboard stays reachable when off. Default: <code>true</code>. Wiki-page overridable.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestEntryPoint</code>
: <code>'button'</code> for this extension's own floating button, <code>'none'</code> to let another extension (SaintapediaFeedback ≥ 1.8.0) open the panel via <code>mw.hook( 'saintapediasuggest.open' )</code>. Default: <code>'button'</code>. Both extensions can coexist with their own buttons stacked; <code>'none'</code> is only needed if you want a single merged entry point.
; <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestWebhook</code> / <code>...Token</code> / <code>...BatchSize</code>
: Optional HTTPS endpoint for <code>maintenance/ProcessSuggestions.php</code>'s offline batch exporter. Defaults: <code>''</code>, <code>''</code>, <code>100</code>. The token is a secret — keep it in <code>LocalSettings.php</code> or the environment.

Each remaining <code>MediaWiki:</code> page name (tables, enabled, notify-users) is itself renameable via the matching <code>*Page</code> variable (for example <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestTablesPage</code>).

=== User rights ===

The three rights are '''independent'''. Granting dashboard access does not grant the other two.

{| class="wikitable"
! Right !! Default !! Grants
|-
| <code>saintapediasuggest-view</code> || sysop || Open the dashboard, triage suggestions, bulk-action
|-
| <code>saintapediasuggest-viewemail</code> || sysop || See the optional contact-email field
|-
| <code>saintapediasuggest-export</code> || sysop || Download the JSON export
|}

These are independent of, and in addition to, the <code>*AccessGroups</code> settings above — a user passes if they hold the right '''or''' belong to an allowed group. A block revokes dashboard access '''and''' submitting, immediately, including partial blocks.

=== Wiki config (MediaWiki: pages) ===

Only content-curation settings get a wiki page — abuse/access controls (rate limit, captcha-required, and who can triage / see emails / export) are deliberately LocalSettings.php-only, for the same reason {{ll|Extension:SaintapediaFeedback|SaintapediaFeedback}}'s equivalent settings are (its 2026-09-10 review, F-08): a <code>MediaWiki:</code> page needs only <code>editinterface</code>, with no deploy or code review, too low a bar for anti-abuse controls.

{| class="wikitable"
! Page !! Format !! Overrides
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaSuggest-tables</code> || one <code>Table: Field1, Field2</code> / <code>Table: *</code> / bare <code>Table</code> line per table || <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestTables</code>
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaSuggest-enabled</code> || <code>true</code>/<code>false</code> || <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestEnabled</code>
|-
| <code>MediaWiki:SaintapediaSuggest-notify-users</code> || one username per line || <code>$wgSaintapediaSuggestNotifyUsers</code>
|}

All are WAN-cached for an hour and invalidated immediately on save, delete or move. '''If a page is missing or empty, the PHP value applies.'''

'''Never put a secret on a MediaWiki: page.''' Those pages are world-readable even though editing them is restricted.

== Usage ==

; Readers
: '''Suggest a correction''' — the floating button on an article with an allow-listed Cargo row (or the toolbox link of the same name), or a hand-off from SaintapediaFeedback's panel if both extensions are installed.
; Editors
: '''Special:SaintapediaSuggest''', or '''Tools → Field suggestions''' on an article for that page's items.
; Offline / LLM-assisted triage
: <code>maintenance/ProcessSuggestions.php</code> posts a batch of pending suggestions to a configured webhook; <code>--dry-run</code> prints the payload without posting or marking anything exported.

Submissions from the widget go through the API module <code>action=saintapediasuggest</code>.

== Privacy and security ==

* '''Every submission is a queue entry, never a direct write.''' Nothing reaches Cargo or wikitext until a human reviewer applies it by hand.
* '''The current value is always re-derived server-side''' at submit time — a client-supplied "current value" would let a submitter fabricate the before-state a reviewer sees.
* '''The contact-email field is off by default''' and, when enabled, is gated behind its own right, independent of dashboard access; the JSON export never includes it.
* '''Access control, the rate limit, and CAPTCHA-required are LocalSettings.php-only''' — weakening them requires a deploy, not just a wiki edit.
* '''The Cargo allow-list, unlike access control, is wiki-editable''' — this is a narrower exposure (it only offers an affordance on fields already selected for exposure, and nothing auto-applies), but allow-listing a field does publish its current value to every reader regardless of whether the template renders it. Treat that wiki page with the same care as reader-facing content.
* '''Captcha fails closed.''' If required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is unavailable or misconfigured, submissions are rejected rather than silently accepted.
* '''Never run with real reader traffic prior to release 0.8.1''' — every claim above rests on unit/integration tests and scratch-wiki verification up to that point, not production use; watch the error log and dashboard closely after a first deploy.
